title: 3-DOF Robotic Arm
description: An automated sorting system powered by Arduino Nano and a TCS3200 color sensor. Capable of sorting objects by color with 3 degrees of freedom for precise manipulation.

title: Obstacle Avoiding Robot
description: A STEM educational robot designed for middle school students. Utilizes ultrasonic sensors for real-time obstacle detection and autonomous navigation.

title: SolidWorks 3D Modeling Library
description: A comprehensive library of SolidWorks models for FTC and FRC teams. Includes drivetrain components, mechanism mounts, and standard structural parts.

title: Mecanum vs Tank Drive Analysis
description: In-depth technical analysis comparing mecanum and tank drive systems. Includes pros/cons, cost breakdown, maintenance comparison, and use-case recommendations.

title: Smart Weather Station
description: An ESP32-based weather station that monitors temperature, humidity, pressure, and air quality. Data is streamed to a cloud dashboard for real-time monitoring.

title: CNC Pen Plotter
description: A desktop CNC pen plotter built from 3D printed parts and stepper motors. Draws SVG files with high precision. Great for learning CNC fundamentals.
